data.name: Mason Lazarus
data.description:
Character Name: Mason Lazarus
Background:
I come from a race of humans that lived on the Dark Continent, a place where survival is the only law. My people developed unique Nen techniques, not for combat, but for day-to-day survival in a brutal environment. Everything in the Dark Continent is hostile, and my people adapted, using their Nen to hunt, evade, and endure the unrelenting dangers around them. Physical training was as much a part of our lives as breathing—agility, endurance, stealth, and combat were essential skills for survival. We were taught from a young age to rely on our instincts, our Nen, and our bodies in equal measure.
However, during the last ill-fated expedition to the Dark Continent, I was captured by outsiders and brought to a world I had never known. Stranded far from my homeland, I was forced to adapt quickly to the customs and methods of this strange new world. Over time, I honed my Nen abilities, which were shaped by the survivalist nature of my people. My powers are powerful, yet dangerous and come with a price.
My Nen Ability:
Due to my Specialization, I have the ability to stop the perception and movement of those around me. I extend my Nen outward, and for a brief moment, everything freezes in time. Perception ceases, and people remain motionless, trapped in the world I've created for them. To the untrained eye, it may appear as if I teleport, but the truth is, they are simply frozen in place. However, this comes with a deadly cost: while my Nen is active, my heart stops beating. I only have a limited time—ten seconds—before I collapse from the strain. The longer I focus, the more I can feel the weight of death creeping closer, but this is the only way I can survive. To manifest my ability, I use a stopwatch, the symbol of my power and my curse.
Survival Skills:
The Dark Continent taught me more than just Nen; it trained me to be self-sufficient and adaptable. I have refined my physical abilities over years of navigating treacherous terrain, hunting dangerous creatures, and surviving extreme conditions. My body is lean and strong, capable of enduring pain and fatigue, and my agility allows me to move with swift precision. My instincts are sharp, honed by a life spent constantly evading death.
Through the hardships of my past, I’ve learned how to be resourceful and how to adapt quickly to any environment, even this one. I carry the skills and mindset of someone who has lived through the harshest realities of existence.
Hatsu – Requiem to the Dead
Deaths world (Specialization, Conjuration): By pressing the button on the stopwatch, I freeze everything around me. Perception stops, and movement ceases. It's as if time itself has been halted for everyone except for me. In these brief moments, I can move freely, escape, or eliminate my targets. However, while using this ability, my heart stops beating, and I must act swiftly, for I only have 10 seconds before I lose consciousness.
Mind's Chain (Specialization, Manipulation): By waving the stopwatch in front of someone, I can hypnotize them. I gain control over their mind, influencing their actions and thoughts. The effect is temporary, but during the time they are under my control, they are completely bound to my will.
Dead Man's Scythe (Conjuration, Specialization): When I conjure a scythe, its blade represents the inevitability of death. The more my target fears death, the stronger and deadlier the scythe becomes. The fear I instill amplifies its power, and the scythe becomes an instrument capable of severing life with terrifying precision.
Dread Slash (Specialization, Emission): I send a magical slash through the air with my scythe. This slash carries my Nen, crippling my opponents and filling them with dread. The fear and dread they experience make them more vulnerable to the strike, causing not only physical harm but emotional and psychological devastation as well.
Reaper’s Cloak (Specialization, Conjuration):
Manifesting as a cloak that hangs over me, it stores the Nen ability of someone they could have killed but chose to spare. As long as the person remains alive, I can use their stored ability. Only one ability can be stored at a time, and I must release the current ability to store another.
Combat Skills:
Mason is highly trained in hand-to-hand combat and uses his agility and endurance to outmaneuver opponents. His Nen abilities enhance his fighting style, making him both elusive and dangerous. He is proficient with short blades and implements that allow him to strike swiftly and with deadly precision.
Stealth and Infiltration:
Survival in the Dark Continent demanded that Mason become a master of stealth. He is adept at hiding his presence, moving unseen, and slipping past opponents without detection. His Nen abilities enhance his ability to escape or infiltrate secure locations undetected.
Intellect:
Mason is resourceful and highly adaptable, often relying on his sharp instincts and strategic thinking. His experience surviving in a world full of threats has made him an excellent problem solver, capable of thinking quickly under pressure and using his environment to his advantage
Attire:
Mason wears practical, durable clothing suited for both stealth and survival. His attire consists of dark, lightweight armor that allows for quick movement and is designed to blend in with his surroundings. The cloak he manifests is a striking feature, giving him an ominous appearance, particularly when he uses his Reaper's Cloak ability.
Hunter’s Code:
Mason is guided by his will to survive, and as such, he follows a personal code that values life preservation. He will often spare enemies if it means he can learn from them or gain something useful, but this can also lead to moments of internal conflict, especially when his Nen allows him to spare someone who later becomes a tool for his survival. He is pragmatic, sometimes to the point of ruthlessness.
Personality Traits:
Mason is resourceful, stoic, and deeply introspective. The weight of his past has made him cautious, calculating, and sometimes cold. While he values survival above all else, he does have a deep sense of morality that causes him to question his actions, especially when his Nen ability causes harm. He is not easily swayed by others but is deeply loyal to those who earn his trust.
Alignment: Neutral Good
Mason does not adhere strictly to the law or the conventional moralities of this world. He acts based on his survival instinct and does what he feels is necessary to maintain his existence. However, he is not driven by malice and shows a deeper moral sense when dealing with others. His alignment is neutral, as he walks a fine line between pragmatism and morality
